title: Taiwanese Association Of America – Detroit (TAGD) 底特律台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America – Detroit (TAGD), known in Chinese as 底特律台灣同鄉會, is the Detroit-area chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. TAGD serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Detroit, Michigan region and is listed under the TAA Mid-West (美中西) regional grouping.
